part.text:
Static site generator implemented with the requested features, tests, and configs. All tests pass locally.

What’s included
- Frontmatter parsing: gray-matter (title, date, tags, draft)
- Markdown rendering: markdown-it with highlight.js syntax highlighting
- Templates: Handlebars with partials and layouts support
- Tag pages: per-tag index pages, optional global tags index if template provided
- RSS: rss.xml generated from non-draft posts (up to 20 latest)
- Dev server: static file server with chokidar watch and WebSocket live reload injection
- CLI: commander with flags for src, templates, out, site-title, site-url, serve, port
- Tests: vitest covering frontmatter parsing, template rendering, and CLI flag behavior
- Configs: package.json, tsconfig.json; fixtures for tests

Key files
- src/cli.ts: CLI entrypoint (bin: ssg)
- src/builder.ts: buildSite, RSS generation, tag pages, live reload injection
- src/markdown.ts: markdown + code highlight + frontmatter
- src/templates.ts: load templates, partials, layouts, render pipeline
- src/server.ts: dev server with WS live reload
- src/types.ts: shared types
- tests/: vitest tests and fixtures (templates and content)

How to use
1. Install deps:
   - npm install
2. Build:
   - npm run build
3. Run CLI (defaults: src=content, templates=templates, out=public):
   - node dist/cli.js --src content --templates templates --out public --site-title "My Site" --site-url https://example.com
4. Dev server with live reload on http://localhost:5173:
   - node dist/cli.js --src content --templates templates --out public --site-title "My Site" --site-url https://example.com --serve --port 5173

Templates
- Place .hbs files in your templates dir:
  - layouts/main.hbs: layout wrapper using {{{body}}}
  - page.hbs: default page template using {{content}}/{{{content}}}
  - tag.hbs: per-tag page (receives context { tag, posts })
  - Optional: templates/partials/*.hbs auto-registered as Handlebars partials

Behavior details
- Draft posts (frontmatter draft: true) are skipped
- A document is treated as a post (included in tags/RSS) if it has a date or lives under a posts/ subfolder
- Per-doc frontmatter can set layout and template
- Tag pages are generated at /tags/<tag>/index.html if tag.hbs exists
- Global tags index is generated at /tags/index.html if a tags.hbs template exists
- Live reload script is injected automatically during --serve builds

Testing
- npm test
- Tests include:
  - Rendering with layouts and highlight.js
  - Exclusion of drafts
  - Tag page generation
  - RSS output basics
  - CLI flags for src/templates/out and site metadata

Notes
- Minimal helpers added: formatDate and json
- RSS uses site-url to produce absolute links; if omitted, links are path-based
- Syntax highlighting uses highlight.js with language class names (e.g., language-js)

If you want example production templates beyond the test fixtures, say the word and I’ll scaffold a more complete starter (home, post list, post, tag, tags index, partials).
